title: DON!! and paying costs
goal: Spend DON!! to play cards, and give DON!! to make your cards stronger.

steps.html: DON!! you've received sit in your Cost area. Upright DON!! are Active, ready to use. To pay a cost, you turn that many DON!! sideways. Now they're Rested until your next turn.

DON!! have a second use. During your Main Phase you can give an active DON!! to your Leader or a Character by tucking it under the card.

  • Each given DON!! is worth +1000 power during your turn.
  • At the start of your next turn, given DON!! come back to your cost area.

Two DON!! words you'll see on cards:

  • [DON!! x1]: this effect only works while the card has at least 1 DON!! given to it.
  • DON!! −1: to use this effect, return 1 DON!! from your table to your DON!! deck.

quiz.q: A Character costs 4. How do you play it?
choices: Return 4 DON!! to your DON!! deck
quiz.why: Paying a cost means resting that many active DON!!.

quiz.q: Your Leader has 5000 power and 2 DON!! given to it. What is its power during your turn?
quiz.why: Each given DON!! adds +1000 during your turn: 5000 + 2000 = 7000.

quiz.q: What does [DON!! x1] on a card mean?
choices: The effect works while it has 1 or more DON!! given
quiz.why: It's a condition: give the card at least 1 DON!! to turn the effect on.
